The original 4x4 representation (left) is reduced to size 2x2 (right) by retaining every other input. Colors on the left indicate which inputs contribute to the outputs on the right. This is effectively what happens with a kernel of stride two, except that the intermediate values are never computed. b) Max pooling. Each output comprises the maximum value of the corresponding 2x2 block. ¢) Mean pooling. Each output is the mean of the values in the 2x2 block.
